patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I got up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom. Next thing I knew I was on the floor. Nothing hurts; I'm mostly embarrassed that my wife found me there.
presentation.triageNote: 69-year-old male with a brief unwitnessed loss of consciousness while standing to urinate during the night, now fully recovered with no injury, chest pain, palpitations, persistent confusion or neurologic deficit.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because an older adult with unwitnessed syncope requires multiple cardiac and medical screening resources despite a classic situational trigger.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient had a brief nocturnal faint while standing to urinate and has fully recovered without injury or focal symptoms.
clinical.acuityReason: An older adult with unwitnessed syncope requires multiple cardiac and medical screening resources despite a classic situational trigger.
keyFindings: Occurred while standing to urinate at night
No chest pain, palpitations, persistent confusion, or deficit
teachingPoints: The timing is classic for micturition syncope: standing suddenly at night, urinating, then a brief reflex faint with rapid recovery. But at 69, an unwitnessed blackout still needs an ECG and assessment for arrhythmia, bleeding, medication effects and orthostasis before the benign label is earned.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A reassuring ECG and medical evaluation would allow discharge with situational precautions and follow-up.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 69-year-old man in a tidy cardigan over sleep clothes and slippers, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting normally and comfortably with both hands loosely folded in his lap
aiImageGeneration.expression: well, alert and mildly sheepish rather than dazed or ill
signs: no bandages, bruises or visible injury
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: completely back to normal after a brief faint
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style with smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines, warm detailed rendering and natural realistic proportions. Match the attached reference image's painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette. Full-body wide shot, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, centered. Show the entire person and entire blue padded clinic chair, including all feet, slippers and chair legs, with generous empty margin on all sides. Subject: a white 69-year-old man in a tidy cardigan over modest sleep clothes and slippers. Pose: sitting normally and comfortably with both hands loosely folded in his lap. Expression: alert, healthy and mildly sheepish, with a small embarrassed half-smile; not dazed, confused, injured or acutely ill. No bruises, bandages, medical equipment, text, logos, shadows, floor plane, watermark or border. Perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background.
